name: DataDesk
shortDescription: CSV analysis with explicit cleaning decisions, descriptive statistics, trends and accessible reports.
features: Explicit cleaning (dropped values reported, never zero-filled)
Descriptive stats incl. median/std and least-squares trend slope (labelled association-only)
Group totals; HTML report with SVG chart + text summary; JSON export
knownLimitations: SVG charts are basic (roadmap: interactive filters)
